title: Beyond Next-Observation Prediction: Agent-Authored World Modeling for Sequential Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2606.25421v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent studies on world modeling for Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically formulate the learning objective as next-observation prediction. However, this objective ties supervision to what a transition happens to reveal, which may omit the dynamics most relevant to the agent's current decision. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Authored World Modeling (AAWM), a training procedure that constructs supervision from the policy's own decision needs. Specifically, at each state, the agent identifies what it needs to understand about the environment before acting. These needs drive the retrieval of relevant transition evidence across trajectories, which is then synthesized into training targets that capture decision-oriented dynamics instead of reconstructing the next observation. This aligns the training objective with the dynamics the policy needs before acting, not with the contents of the next observation. Experimental results

translated_title: 超越下一观测预测：面向序列决策的智能体自主世界建模
translated_abstract: 近年来针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的世界建模研究通常将学习目标设定为下一观测预测。然而，这一目标将监督信号与状态转移所恰好揭示的内容绑定在一起，可能遗漏与智能体当前决策最相关的环境动态。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了智能体自主世界建模（Agent-Authored World Modeling, AAWM），这是一种从策略自身决策需求出发构建监督信号的训练方法。具体而言，在每一状态下，智能体首先识别其在行动前需要理解环境的哪些方面；这些需求驱动在多条轨迹中检索相关的转移证据，随后将其综合为捕捉面向决策的动态规律的训练目标，而非简单重构下一观测。这使得训练目标与策略在行动前所需的动态信息保持一致，而非与下一观测的内容保持一致。实验结果……
tldr: 该论文提出智能体自主世界建模（AAWM），让智能体根据自身行动前的决策需求主动检索并综合环境转移证据来构建训练监督，从而学习与决策相关的环境动态，而非单纯预测下一观测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agent-Authored World Modeling (AAWM), where the agent identifies its own decision needs, retrieves relevant transition evidence across trajectories, and synthesizes decision-oriented training targets instead of reconstructing the next observation, aligning world model training with the dynamics the policy needs before acting.
